node.statement: There are universal D_2 < infinity and e_2 > 0, chosen with e_2 <= e_s2 and C_s2*e_2 <= e_ext, such that every explicit Stage-2 raw-call closed EXT-CB datum in A_R whose total post-helper defect is at most C_s2*t, for base scale 0 <= t <= e_2, admits an extended D_2*t-isomorphism M_{r+1}->A_R.
